How I work

Three things I always do

Every project is different, but these three habits show up in all of them.

Understand the people

I don’t start designing until I know who the product is for and where they get stuck. A few honest conversations save weeks of rework.

Simplify every step

I map the whole flow and remove every step, word and choice that doesn’t help the main task — until it feels obvious.

Prove it with users

I test with users whenever I can, fix what confuses them, and hand developers files they don’t have to guess about.
